_comment: Street furniture and tree dimensions, metres: the ONE place the drawn model and the solid collider both get their size from. tools/blender/props/*.py builds each model so its body has radius `r` over the heights `measure`, src/shared/props.ts makes a box of half size `r` (up to `solidH` high) solid, and tests/anchorProps.test.ts measures the exported .glb against it. A tree's `r` is the trunk radius at 0.9 to 1.1 m on a tree of the reference crown radius `refR` (it scales with the crown). `refH` is the height the model is built at (the instance is scaled to the anchor's height).
